Works with / claude.ai

Skills for claude.ai: free and tested

How our skills run in claude.ai, and where to start.

claude.ai does not read a folder on your computer. You upload the skill as a ZIP under Customize, then Skills, and code execution must be switched on in Settings. Some of our downloads include ready-made zips; for the others, zip the skill folder yourself.

Step-by-step install page for claude.ai, with the official docs it comes from.

Tested on

Our release tests ran on Claude Sonnet, and on Claude Opus for some skills; each skill page says what it was tested on. We do not claim a separate test in claude.ai. The skills are plain files in the open SKILL.md format, so any assistant that reads that format should be able to load them, but we have not verified each tool. How we test.
